published.source: Raid damage hits on warriors (2 a minute, 1500 damage each), 2026-10-15

summary: Two-hand Arms in Battle Stance: Mortal Strike, Slam on its cooldown, Overpower off dodges and Bloodthrill procs, with Rend kept up and Weaponmaster's axe crit. It is the Arms spec's Level 60 preset, about 10% behind dual wield Fury.
rotation: Sunder Armor as the first GCD after the pull (every warrior; the tanks keep it up after)
With 25 sec left, Recklessness ready and under 25 Rage: swap to Berserker Stance, and back to Battle Stance once Recklessness is out
Death Wish held for the last 36 sec, Recklessness in the last 25 sec; racials with Death Wish (Blood Fury and Berserking also at the end of the fight)
Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, second held for the last 20 sec; Bloodrage under 10 Rage
Slam from 20 Rage (15 sec cooldown with Improved Slam), outside execute
Rend kept up outside execute; then Execute
Heroic Strike from 70 Rage, Hamstring filler from 20 Rage (outside execute)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 30 Strength and 16 crit rating, and 335 attack power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown

Rage from white hits is normalised to the weapon: k × swing speed (k 3.46 one-hand, 4.5 two-hand, measured at level 30), growing with level to ×1.5 at 60 (s = 0.5), the off hand the same. An assumption until measured at 60
Synthetic Phase 1 gear on Forever's physical budget (ids 991001-991018)
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Heroic Strike VIII, raid Battle Shout VI, Strength of Earth, Grace of Air)
Deep Wounds ticks can't crit (client attribute); Deep Wounds tick timer restarting on each crit is a modelling choice
Crit Rage bonus assumed white hits only; Heroic Strike swings count for Unbridled Wrath (open assumptions)
One +2% crit elixir a character: whether Ferocity stacks with Mongoose in game is open; a second crit elixir (Grizzly) would add 10.9
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece (+36 AP vs Humanoids) not counted (would add 8.4 at Undead 180 s)
Booming Voice (5/5) does nothing because the raid has Battle Shout
Arms in Berserker Stance with Whirlwind all fight was 10% behind
Raid damage hits on the warrior (2 a minute at 1500 damage, about 15 Rage each) are an estimate from boss timers, not measured in logs; the assumptions panel runs 0 and 10 a minute
notes: Request from mksettings -spec arms -gear level60_phase1_synthetic_arms -apl level60_arms -talents 20305213032515201-55050000001 -race Orc -duration 180, unedited (mksettings sets the raid hits, 2 a minute at 1500). Not the class default: the warrior UI has one spec page and its default Level 60 build is Fury Dual Wield; this is the only Arms preset. Raid buffs, Kings and Might, debuffs, consumes, professions (Engineering, Alchemy) and the Level 60 encounter match ui/warrior/presets.ts.
